# New Modern Beauty Salon

> Premium Women & Kids Beauty Studio in Limbodi, Indore. Established 2011.

## About
New Modern Beauty Salon is an exclusive women and children's beauty salon in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. Founded by senior beauty expert Ranjana Singh, certified by Orane International and Savera's Makeup Academy.

## Key Information
- **Founder & Senior Expert:** Ranjana Singh (15+ years experience)
- **Target Audience:** Women and Kids only (Exclusive private environment)
- **Address:** 104, 66 Raj Avenue, Shri Krishna Avenue, Phase 3, Limbodi, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452010, India
- **Phone:** +91 90393 62327
- **WhatsApp:** https://wa.me/919039362327
- **Hours:** Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM - 8:00 PM (Closed on Sundays)
- **Website:** https://newmodernbeautysalon.com

## Services
- **Bridal & Special Occasion:** HD Bridal Makeup, Engagement Makeup, Party Makeup, Saree Draping, Bridal Packages
- **Hair Care & Styling:** Modern Haircuts, Keratin Treatment, Nanoplastia, Botox Hair Therapy, Hair Spa & Repair, Hair Coloring
- **Skin Care & Facials:** Hydra Facial, O3+ Facial, Fruit/Oxy/Detan Bleach, Deep Cleansing Treatments, Threading, Waxing
- **Body & Wellness:** Luxury Manicure & Pedicure, Nail Art, Body Polishing, Back Massage
- **Kids Services:** Gentle Kids Haircuts, Kids Grooming
